items.summary: The job search that runs on your machine. AI job application framework built on Claude Code: evaluate postings, tailor CVs, write cover letters, prep interviews. Fork it and own it.
items.recommend_reason_zh: MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search 是本地 AI 求职框架，评估岗位、定制简历、写求职信、准备面试。
items.recommend_reason_en: MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search is a local AI job application framework built on Claude Code that evaluates postings, tailors CVs, writes cover letters, and preps interviews, making it worth opening to fork and own your job search.

items.summary: Give your AI agent 31 web tools in one MCP server
items.recommend_reason_zh: CrawlForge MCP 把 31 个网页工具装进一个 MCP 服务器，让 AI 智能体一次接入即可调用，省去逐个配置的麻烦，值得打开体验。
items.recommend_reason_en: CrawlForge MCP bundles 31 web tools into a single MCP server, giving an AI agent a broad toolkit worth opening when you want many web capabilities in one place.

items.summary: Solution for long term memory for agent coding CLIs and to facilitate handoff between different agent vendors
items.recommend_reason_zh: akitaonrails/ai-memory 为 agent coding CLI 提供长期记忆，并便于在不同 agent 厂商之间交接，适合需要跨工具延续上下文的开发者体验。
items.recommend_reason_en: akitaonrails/ai-memory provides long-term memory for agent coding CLIs and aims to facilitate handoff between different agent vendors, making it worth opening when switching agents.

items.summary: The smartest AI support agent for customer success

items.recommend_reason_en: Tori is pitched as a smart AI support agent for customer success, and it is worth opening to explore how it approaches customer success support.
